questions.stem: From the same table ($20$ males-cats, $15$ males-dogs, $25$ females-cats, $20$ females-dogs, total $80$), a person is chosen at random. Given the person is female, what is the probability she likes cats?
questions.explanation: Total females $= 25 + 20 = 45$. Given the person is female, $P(\text{cats}\,|\,\text{female}) = \frac{25}{45} = \frac{5}{9}$.
